script.title: THE WRONG COFFEE SHOP
script.story_hook: A first meetup almost goes wrong at a café.
script.intro_zh: 網友第一次見面，差點在咖啡店錯身而過。
script.welcome_en: Welcome back, friends! Today two new meetup friends finally meet.
script.welcome_zh: 歡迎回來，朋友們！今天兩位剛認識的網友終於見面了。
script.outro: That's today's episode! Keep listening, keep speaking.
script.outro_zh: 以上就是今天的內容！繼續聽、繼續說。
script.practice_intro_en: Now echo every line with feeling!
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在請帶著感情，逐句跟我唸！
script.char_a_description: a slim woman in her late twenties with shoulder-length auburn hair and side-swept bangs, wearing round glasses, a mustard yellow knit cardigan and dark jeans, waving slightly as she half stands
script.char_b_description: an average-built man in his early thirties with tousled brown hair and a light stubble, wearing a bright red zip-up windbreaker over a white tee and gray joggers, catching his breath while he smiles
script.youtube_title: 【☕第一次網友見面】走錯咖啡店怎麼辦？🙋描述穿著・遲到道歉的真實英文✨｜First Meetup English
script.youtube_title_en: "I Was at the Wrong Coffee Shop" — A First Meetup
script.youtube_description:
第一次跟網友見面，怕的不是沒話聊，是根本找不到人！這集跟著 Nina 和 Dave 經歷走錯店、遲到、打電話沒接到的真實烏龍，學好道歉、描述穿著、化解尷尬的實用英文。整段 18 句自然美式口語，附繁體中文翻譯與 IPA 標音，後半段逐句跟讀，聽完見面不再怕。
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
訂閱我們的頻道，每天一集，讓英文變成你的直覺！
script.youtube_description_en:
The scariest part of a first meetup isn't the small talk — it's not being able to find the other person! In this episode, Nina and Dave survive the wrong coffee shop, a late arrival, and missed calls. You'll learn how to apologize, describe what you're wearing, and turn an awkward moment into a good laugh. 18 lines of natural American English with IPA and translations, plus a repeat-after-me section.
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
Subscribe for a new episode every day!
script.youtube_title_ref: 【🎬沉浸式英文動畫】☕初次見面英文｜遲到道歉・走錯店家・描述穿著｜聽完就能安心約見面｜🌱A2 初級英文｜💡不用背，多聽就會用｜🎧聽力口說練習｜後段逐句跟讀
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
第一次約見網友，對方遲到、又找不到人，怎麼辦？
「穿紅外套」用英文到底怎麼講才自然？

這一集帶大家走進週日上午的咖啡店，跟著等了快半小時的 Nina，經歷走錯店、電話進語音信箱的烏龍見面，最後用一句玩笑話化解尷尬。

你會聽到：
😅 遲到與道歉：例如「I'm so late, right?」、「Honestly, I was at the wrong coffee shop.」。
🧥 描述穿著認人：例如「I'm the one in the mustard cardigan.」、「Good thing I wore the red jacket」。
☕ 化解與續約：例如「No worries!」、「Same table next Saturday then?」。

後半段是逐句聽力加上跟讀練習 🎧，先完整聽一遍，再跟著一句一句唸，把這些安撫與自嘲的語氣變成直覺。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用死背，跟著情境反覆聽，自然就會用。

下次約見面，就算走錯店，你也笑得出來！
script.thumbnail_action: waving hello across a small café table

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, are you Dave from the book club?
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ ɑr ju deɪv frʌm ðə bʊk klʌb/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，你是讀書會的大衛嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nina? Oh my gosh, yes! I'm so late, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈninə oʊ maɪ ɡɑʃ jɛs aɪm soʊ leɪt raɪt/
dialogue.zh: 妮娜？天啊，是我！我超遲到對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It's okay, I just got here five minutes ago.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ˈoʊkeɪ aɪ dʒʌst ɡɑt hɪr faɪv ˈmɪnɪts ˈəˌɡoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 沒事啦，我也是五分鐘前才到。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Honestly, I was at the wrong coffee shop.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɑnəstli aɪ wəz æt ðə rɔŋ ˈkɔfi ʃɑp/
dialogue.zh: 老實說，我剛剛走錯咖啡店了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The one across the street? Well, that explains it!
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə wʌn əˈkrɔs ðə strit wɛl ðæt ɪkˈspleɪnz ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 就在對面那間嗎？我就說嘛！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I called twice, but your phone went to voicemail.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ kɔld twaɪs bət jɔr foʊn wɛnt tə ˈvɔɪsˌmeɪl/
dialogue.zh: 我打了兩次電話，但你的手機直接進語音信箱。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sorry about that, it was on silent the whole time.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɑri əˈbaʊt ðæt ɪt wəz ɑn ˈsaɪlənt ðə hoʊl taɪm/
dialogue.zh: 抱歉，它一整天都設成靜音。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No worries! You look just like your profile photo.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈwɜriz ju lʊk dʒʌst laɪk jɔr ˈproʊfaɪl ˈfoʊtoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 別在意！你跟大頭貼上長得一模一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha! And I'm the one in the mustard cardigan.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ænd aɪm ði wʌn ɪn ðə ˈmʌstər ˈkɑrdəˌɡæn/
dialogue.zh: 哈！我就是那個穿芥末黃針織開襟的人。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good thing I wore the red jacket, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd θɪŋ aɪ wɔr ðə rɛd ˈdʒækət raɪt/
dialogue.zh: 對吧？還好我穿了那件紅外套。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Very right. Please sit down, you look exhausted!
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈvɛri raɪt pliz sɪt daʊn ju lʊk ɪɡˈzɔstəd/
dialogue.zh: 非常正確。快坐下，你看起來累壞了！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two blocks in these boots, lesson learned!
dialogue.phonetic: /tu blɑks ɪn ðiz buts ˈlɛsən lɜrnd/
dialogue.zh: 穿雨鞋走了兩條街，我學到教訓了！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let me buy you a coffee for that, my treat.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt mi baɪ ju ə ˈkɔfi fər ðæt maɪ trit/
dialogue.zh: 讓我請你喝杯咖啡吧，這頓我請。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Deal! Large latte, please, it's been a morning.
dialogue.phonetic: /dil lɑrdʒ ˈlæteɪ pliz ɪts bɪn ə ˈmɔrnɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 成交！請給我大杯拿鐵，這早上夠折騰的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Same for me. So, did anyone finish the book?
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪm fər mi soʊ dɪd ˈɛniwʌn ˈfɪnɪʃ ðə bʊk/
dialogue.zh: 我也要一樣。那麼，有人把書讀完了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I finished half, so we have plenty to discuss.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ˈfɪnɪʃt hæf soʊ wi hæv ˈplɛnti tə dɪˈskʌs/
dialogue.zh: 我只讀完一半，所以我們有很多可聊的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect. Same table next Saturday then?
dialogue.zh: 太好了。那下週六一樣這個位置？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wouldn't miss it. Thanks for waiting, Nina.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʊdnt mɪs ɪt θæŋks fər ˈweɪtɪŋ ˈninə/
dialogue.zh: 我可不會錯過。謝謝你等我，妮娜。
